_comment: Shared contract for desktop data-home resolution parity.
Consumed by BOTH sides of the two-language mirror:
- test/test_home_resolution_parity.py lays each case out on disk,
runs the REAL backend resolver (config.paths.config_dir), and
asserts the config content at the backend's resolved home AFTER
migration equals the content that expected_read_home held BEFORE
migration -- i.e. the bytes Electron reads pre-spawn are the bytes
Change paths.py semantics and the Python gate fails; update this
fixture and the JS suite fails until home-dir.js follows. That is the
parity gate: neither implementation can drift alone.
Fields: env_override -- KIROCREW_HOME set to a distinct dir;
migration completion marker exist at boot. marker=true requires
canonical=true (the marker lives inside the canonical home).
